source.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា
source.description: Preparation exam — function exercise III: f(x) = (x^2-4x)/(x^2-4x+3) — domain, limits, asymptotes, derivative, tangents.
source.extracted_by: manual transcription from preparation exam (2026-08), answers verified with SymPy

prompt:
We have the function f defined by f(x) = (x^2 - 4x)/(x^2 - 4x + 3), with graph (C).
1. Find the domain of f, then compute lim_{x→1^-} f(x), lim_{x→1^+} f(x), lim_{x→3^-} f(x), lim_{x→3^+} f(x) and lim_{x→±∞} f(x).
2. Find the equations of the asymptotes of (C).
3. Compute f'(x) and build the variation table of f.
4. Find the equations of the tangents to (C) at x = 0 and x = 4.
5. Draw (C) together with the tangents.
prompt_latex: \text{គេមានអនុគមន៍ } y=f(x)=\frac{x^2-4x}{x^2-4x+3} \text{ មានក្រាប } (C) .\\ \text{1. រកដែនកំណត់នៃ } f \text{ រួចគណនា } \lim_{x\to 1^-} f(x)\ ;\ \lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x)\ ;\ \lim_{x\to 3^-} f(x)\ ;\ \lim_{x\to 3^+} f(x) \text{ និង } \lim_{x\to \pm\infty} f(x) .\\ \text{2. រកសមីការអាស៊ីមតូតនៃក្រាប } (C) .\\ \text{3. គណនា } f'(x) \text{ រួចសង់តារាងអថេរភាពនៃ } f .\\ \text{4. កំណត់សមីការបន្ទាត់ប៉ះនៃក្រាប } (C) \text{ ត្រង់ } x=0 \text{ និង } x=4 .\\ \text{5. សង់ក្រាប } (C) \text{ ព្រមទាំងបន្ទាត់ប៉ះទាំងពីរ។}

parts.question_km: រកដែនកំណត់នៃ $f$ រួចគណនាលីមីតត្រង់ $1^{\pm}, 3^{\pm}$ និង $\pm\infty$
parts.technique: The denominator x² - 4x + 3 = (x-1)(x-3) vanishes at x = 1 and x = 3, so D = R \ {1,3}. Limits: at 1⁻ → -∞, 1⁺ → +∞, 3⁻ → +∞, 3⁺ → -∞, and both ±∞ → 1.

parts.question_km: រកសមីការអាស៊ីមតូតនៃក្រាប $(C)$
parts.technique: The limits at ±∞ are both 1, so the horizontal asymptote is y = 1. The vertical asymptotes x = 1 and x = 3 come from the one-sided limits in part 1.

parts.question_km: គណនា $f'(x)$ រួចសង់តារាងអថេរភាពនៃ $f$
parts.technique: By the quotient rule f'(x) = 6(x-2)/((x-1)²(x-3)²). Its sign is the sign of x - 2, so f decreases on (-∞,1) ∪ (1,2) and increases on (2,3) ∪ (3,∞): local minimum at x = 2, f(2) = 4.

parts.question_km: កំណត់សមីការបន្ទាត់ប៉ះនៃក្រាប $(C)$ ត្រង់ $x=0$ និង $x=4$
parts.technique: f(4) = 0 and f'(4) = 4/3, so the tangent at x = 4 is y = (4/3)x - 16/3. (The tangent at x = 0 is y = -(4/3)x, given as a checkpoint.)

parts.question_km: សង់ក្រាប $(C)$ ព្រមទាំងបន្ទាត់ប៉ះទាំងពីរ
parts.technique: Sketch (C) with the vertical asymptotes x = 1, x = 3, the horizontal asymptote y = 1, and the two tangents at x = 0 and x = 4.
